role: The thrown egg: a 0-damage thrown hit, a 1-in-8 chance of spawning one (1-in-32 of four) baby chickens, and snowballpoof particles.
scope_reason: A throwable the replay's throw-items scene exercises; chickens are in scope.

members.name: EntityEgg
members.note: n/a: EntityList registers no name for EntityEgg, so an egg is never saved (writeToNBTOptional needs getEntityString) or read back; the client builds its copy with (World, DDD). cov-reload-s1 throws one across an unload: it is gone after, on both sides

members.name: onImpact
members.note: the 1-in-8 chick roll, the 1-in-32 four-chick roll, the growth age and the poof; living.c 568 carries the chicken side

notes: The EntityThrowable base (heading, gravity, flight, the hit test) is projectile.c's throwable half; only this class's own onImpact is its own code.
